narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The diagonals are equal and cut each other in half, so it must be a square.
<bookmark mark='glow'/>For a square, the strips must cross at a right angle.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>These cross at sixty degrees, so eigh B is shorter than eigh D. It is not a square.

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Equal halves make four triangles, each with two equal sides.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Each corner takes one base angle from two different triangles.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Two equal strips cut in half cross at fifty degrees. Find the base angles of each triangle.
